E21_componentwise.interpretation: For positive source amplitudes and independent symmetric multiplicative response uncertainty ±eta applied to each candidate state, F+ and F- prediction intervals at component j remain disjoint iff eta < (Cplus-Cminus)/(Cplus+Cminus).

comparison.statement: At source level only, the conditional E19 T3/T1 ratio tolerates ~28.6 times larger symmetric relative calibration uncertainty than requiring non-overlap in all four E21 long-K components.

limits: not a survey sensitivity or sigma
not a physical model for response uncertainty
no covariance, window, HOD, or velocity reconstruction
E19 and E21 are different estimands
